liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Return To Oz Chat**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]

## The recordings

- **mmj2011-06-29.VancouverBC.matrix.16bit** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 141 min [1]
- **mmj2011-06-29.Vancouver.CA-11.24bit**: source not stated; 24 songs; 141 min [3]
- **mmj2011-06-29.Vancouver.Busman.24bit**: source not stated; 24 songs; 141 min [5]. Said about its sound: Very occasional and minor clipping occurred during the first couple of minutes [5]
- **mmj2011-06-29.Vancouver.matrix.24bit**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 141 min [2]

## Around the show

- Recorded from front row of the dress circle, five meters from the stage [1]
- Microphones were clamped to the railing in the front row of the dress circle [3]
- Mentions an upcoming tour with Alison Krauss following the August 2011 shows [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2011-06-29.VancouverBC.matrix.16bit**: taped by Seth Meister; transferred by Dennis Orr; source: CA-11 cardiods > CA-9100 (1/8" input) + BSC-1 K1 cardiods (XLR input) > Zoom H4n @ 24 bit/48 kHz [1]. Also: CA-11 and BSC-1 mics recorded to Zoom H4n, then processed through Audacity and Wavelab [1]
- **mmj2011-06-29.Vancouver.CA-11.24bit**: taped by Seth Meister; transferred by Dennis Orr; source: CA-11 cardiods > CA-9100 > Zoom H4n (1/8" input) @ 24 bit/48 kHz [3]. Also: CA-11 cardioids captured on Zoom H4n, later normalized and tracked in Sound Forge [3]
- **mmj2011-06-29.Vancouver.Busman.24bit**: taped by Seth Meister; transferred by Dennis Orr; source: BSC-1 (K1 cardiods) > Zoom H4n (XLR input) @ 24 bit/48 kHz [5]. Also: BSC-1 K1 cardioids recorded to Zoom H4n, then edited in Audacity and Sound Forge [5]
- **mmj2011-06-29.Vancouver.matrix.24bit**: taped by Seth Meister; transferred by Dennis Orr; source: CA-11 cardiods > CA-9100 (1/8" input) + BSC-1 K1 cardiods (XLR input) > Zoom H4n @ 24 bit/48 kHz [2]
